identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase III Study of ESG401 for Unresectable Recurrent or Metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Phase III Study of ESG401 Versus Investigator's Choice Chemotherapy as First-line Treatment in Patients With Unresectable Recurrent or Metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ESG401 as first-line treatment in patients with unresectable recurrent or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a randomized, open-label, multicenter Phase 3 study to evaluate ESG401 versus Investigator's Choice Chemotherapy (ICC) as first-line treatment in subjects with unresectable recurrent or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.

armGroups.label: ESG401 for injection
armGroups.description: IV infusion on day 1, 8 and15 of each 28 day cycle

armGroups.label: Investigator's Choice Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: If no prior taxane, or prior taxane in the (neo)adjuvant setting and disease-free interval (DFI) \>12 months: paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel. Note: If subjects are intolerant or contraindicated to receive paclitaxel or albumin-paclitaxel, the investigator may choose other chemotherapy options listed in the study protocol) If prior taxane and DFI ≤ 12 months: capecitabine, eribulin. If known BRCA1/2 mutation: carboplatin

interventions.name: ESG401
interventions.description: IV infusion on day 1,8, and 15 of each 28 day cycle

interventions.name: Investigator's Choice Chemotherapy
interventions.description: Paclitaxel, Nab-paclitaxel, Capecitabine, Eribulin, or Carboplatin

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression Free Survival (PFS) assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
primaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from randomization to the first documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 based on BICR or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.
Defined as the time from randomization until the date of death due to any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from randomization to the first documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 based on investigator or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the percentage of patients who achieve complete response(CR) or partial response (PR), as assessed by BICR per RECIST 1.1

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease control rate (DCR) assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the percentage of patients who achieve CR, PR or stable disease (SD), as assessed by BICR per RECIST 1.1

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of Response (DoR) assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from the date of first documented CR or PR until date of documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1, as assessed by BICR or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to Response (TTR) assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from the date of randomization until the first documentation of CR or PR as assessed by BICR per RECIST 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) assessed by Investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the percentage of patients who achieve complete response(CR) or partial response (PR), as assessed by investigator per RECIST 1.1

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease control rate (DCR) assessed by Investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the percentage of patients who achieve CR, PR or stable disease (SD), as assessed by investigator per RECIST 1.1

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of Response (DoR) assessed by Investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from the date of first documented CR or PR until date of documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1, as assessed by investigator or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to Response (TTR) assessed by Investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from the date of randomization until the first documentation of CR or PR as assessed by investigator per RECIST 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Quality of life evaluated using the NCC-BC-A scale
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the impact of ESG401 on disease related symptoms and quality of life of patients using the NCC-BC-A scale

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Adverse events(AEs) and severe adverse events (SAEs)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of AEs and SAEs (per CTCAE 5.0), and clinically significant abnormal laboratory findings
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From signing the ICF up to last dose plus 30 days

secondaryOutcomes.description: Mean population clearance will be derived from pooled data of drug concentrations. Covariates of influence on drug clearance will be incorporated within a population pharmacokinetic model.

Mean population volume of distribution will be derived from pooled data of drug concentrations. Covariates of influence on volume of distribution will be incorporated within a population pharmacokinetic model.
